notes.title: Lasers and steam playtest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231352/8dbd86ec0d475f11b34217f684dcd46c74bd02f1.png[/img]

First off I want to thank everyone who has provided feedback on the current playtest builds.

If you haven't already, I'd love to hear from everyone who has played public playtest build here on steam or itch. Click here to go to the [url=https://forms.gle/4aqBeFC6fZ1e7Heq9]feedback form.[/url]

Moving on, I've uploaded a new build of the playtest this weekend, besides numerous small and minor changes and bug fixes, it includes additional Augments that are now implemented, a quick action mode, and lasers. 

Here are two of the new augments. The first is the dead switch which lets dead agents contribute to the fight by turning them into proximity mines. If they have C4 charges in their inventory they increase in power.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231352/165d2ee46ed9af648e842170cc6696a7b115dece.png[/img]

Second is the mordake cyclopes which by surgically grating one eye on the back of the agents head gives them vision behind them at the cost of smaller field of vision forward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231352/01fa9f775efa04b038537738a2d0eb39dc38b9b0.png[/img]

As for the Lasers, they are just fun, they melt through wall, enemies, and players alike. But that power comes at the cost of low ammunition and slow reloading. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231352/03b8eb9ced874142891fcb3b055356c7f73514b0.gif[/img]

The quick action mode, lets players quickly outfit agents with equipment and augments before jumping into any mission they want. Its still rough but it lets you get into the action without dealing with all the agent and mission management elements that will be in the city conquest mode.

I'm going to try and make these updates and build uploads more consistent. 

Till next time. 
Francisco

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231352/a059a39548344a9e98ae82887edfe321efd65a23.png[/img]

notes.title: Development update and feedback demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231352/e293c38e27d37f899926b064ef7ed019a86b5123.png[/img]

It's been a more than a few months since I've posted anywhere on the status of Brain Hack Squad and for that I am sorry. I plan to make updates are more regular occurrence in order to keep everyone up to date on the game's development. For now I have two things to share today....

First I have uploaded a short video on youtube, giving a basic rundown of the games core game play loop. Check it out.

[previewyoutube=JLsArsM9Sbg;full][/previewyoutube]

Second I have published a feedback demo on itch.io. Why do this? Why call it a feedback demo? Because I want to get some feedback from fans of the game and fans of Real Time Tactic games. It has some known issues, and the screen resolution is currently locked in the build, only allowing for windowed or full screen.

The current demo is only in English.

[h1]You can find the demo here... [url=https://cetve.itch.io/brain-hack-squad-demo]Brain Hack Squad Feedback demo.[/url][/h1]

The feedback form is linked to from inside the game, but you can also find it here... [url=https://forms.gle/4aqBeFC6fZ1e7Heq9]feedback form.[/url]
